title: Adic stratified finite presentations and finite constant local models
statement: Fix a universe $u$ and a prime $\ell$. Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme in universe $u$, meaning quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring with its specified multiplication and a certificate [def-sfb-adic-coefficient-certificate] of one of the three families $\mathcal O_E$, $E$, or $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, where $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite. For the algebraic closure use the finite-subextension-valued ring of [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]. Put $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ and $D_X=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X})$ [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Under the section-action equivalence [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence], a $\Lambda_X$-module $M$ is constructible in the stratified local-finite-presentation sense [def-sfb-constructible-module] if and only if it is constructible in the finite constant local model sense [sk-def-sfb-constructible]: there is a finite constructible locally closed stratification $X=\coprod_aX_a$ and on every stratum a pro-étale cover $\{U_{ai}\to X_a\}$ and finitely presented scalar $\Lambda(*)$-modules $P_{ai}$ with $M|_{U_{ai}}\cong\Lambda_{U_{ai}}\otimes_{\Lambda(*)}P_{ai}$. The stratifications on the two sides may differ, and integral torsion scalar modules are allowed. Consequently the bounded constructible full subcategory $\mathcal B_X$ of [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible] equals $\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$ of [sk-def-sfb-constructible], as object properties in the same ordinary derived category $D_X$. No derived-completeness condition is imposed.
